```{r}
library(PKbioanalysis)
library(dplyr)

```

```{r}
d <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "GU_1.csv", package = "PKbioanalysis"))
```

```{r}
head(d)
```

```{r}
only_qc <- d |> filter(TYPE %in% c("LLOQ", "LQC", "MQC", "HQC"))

only_qc <- only_qc  |> 
    group_by(TYPE, stdconc) |>
    summarize(
        mean = mean(conc),
        sd = sd(conc),
        cv = sd(conc)/mean(conc)*100,
        n = n()
    )
only_qc
```

```{r}
plot_var_pattern(only_qc)
```


```{r}
fit <- fit_var(d)


formated_print(fit)

```
